Hardware and protocols are legitimate design choices for the accepted finite construction; uniqueness is not its completion requirement. Mapping those objects to all broader physical theorem premises is a separate common-model task. The abstract counterpair does not establish two physical realizations or an all-sector independence result; the scalar seams do not deliver remote records.
